pull_request.title: Calorimeter: prototype a 400 mm LAr barrel-endcap gap
pull_request.head: codex/lar-gap400-prototype
pull_request.body:
Add the user-requested **400 mm barrel/endcap warm-envelope gap prototype** above #150. The selected 1 m-gap LAr baseline remains unchanged. Move both complete endcaps600mm toward the IP, retaining all sampling depths, local pieces/materials/masses, readout counts and HCAL context.

**Merge order: #147 → #148 → #149 → #150 → this PR.** Earlier task-parent and child accounting remains canonical and preserved. This prototype has its own paired journal, compact controls and accounting record.

The explicit alternative policy checks R400 bends against a1000mm pre-end band, annular140mm service lanes and distinct barrel/endcap utility sectors. It retains the original front-S-bend validator, which still rejects400mm without an alternative route policy. The rear endcap interval becomes1100mm while the HCAL radial-exit window remains500mm.

**Route reservations are unconstructed:** closed vessel ports, board/H-ring swept clearances, headers and individual bundle engineering remain open. No new external service material is added to the native model. The prospective forward-collar conflict is retained and illustrated, rather than treated as validated full-detector integration.

![Conditional400mm LAr gap](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/9ec2558a8cf30d2e7e7ad5b2d07520ccd0138b95/docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-002-gap400-rz.png?raw=true)

[Design and assumptions](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-gap400-prototype/docs/design/inputs/DES-032-gap400-prototype.md) · [SVG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-gap400-prototype/docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-002-gap400-rz.svg) · [Controls and recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-gap400-prototype/docs/validation/lar-gap400/README.md)

Validation:46 calorimeter tests pass. The selected1m baseline still reproduces all four validated component XML/material files byte-for-byte, and its retained SVG remains byte-identical. The400mm variant keeps barrel XML/material bytes and local endcap pieces/materials/masses, with correct signed600mm translations. Native endcap and ECAL-union audits pass with **zero overlaps at1e-5mm**;405 finite material/sensitive rays retained. Matched24-event serial/12-worker transport/readback passes with all **19,568 hit cell IDs, energies and positions exactly equal** by event ID.

This is ECAL-only,B=0 geometry and transport smoke evidence. There is no new10k resolution/precision claim, calibration transfer, engineering acceptance or baseline replacement. Independent SysArch and PhysVal reviews of9ec2558a8cf30d2e7e7ad5b2d07520ccd0138b95 plusfcbc6a912038feb2cfe32a2b206bd582b6983d7b found no material publication blocker. A drawing-metadata correction separates baseline context from active ECAL identity; scientific figures and controls are unchanged. Four exact closed specialist turns are accounted once, with current shared parent excluded. Raw events/native ROOT geometry, full expected exports and bulky logs remain local.

Tracking: TASK-LAR-HADRON-GAP-OPTIONS; DES-032/033. Draft for review; no main merge or ready action.

events.text:
**LAR-GAP400-CaloTech**, exact source **7a9da4490f3bbe89f9d55fbfcadc795a3889139b**. Read-only source inspection and standard-library arithmetic; **no files changed or native execution**.

A **conditional 400 mm gap study is defensible** with explicit pre-end side-neck/straight-bus reservations. The current model does **not** establish a connected physical route through its closed vessel walls, supports and unmodeled headers.

Keep all restored sampling, materials, bath/wall allocations, readout and pipe sizes fixed. Translate each complete endcap **600 mm toward the IP**:

| Boundary, absolute z | 1 m baseline | 400 mm variant |
|---|---:|---:|
| Warm front/back | 5100–6260 | **4500–5660 mm** |
| Cold front/back | 5200–6110 | **4600–5510 mm** |
| Sampling front/back | 5210–5860 | **4610–5260 mm** |
| Sampling depth | 650 | **650 mm** |

The barrel remains at warm half-length 4100 mm; sampling axial separation becomes **700 mm**.

**Correction to the assignment’s inherited sizing numbers:** executing pinned `compact_prototype.configs(restored-sampling.json)` and `services.budget()` gives restored N₂ radius **2547 mm**, bus radius **3029 mm**, and offset **482 mm**. Existing front S-bend bounds are **834.082/854.082 mm** for 80/100 mm jackets. The quoted 896.8/916.8 mm values belong to the earlier dense compact control. Either construction still fails 400 mm.

Use a separate, explicit route-policy branch:

- Default retains the existing front-S-bend validator.
- New opt-in policy could be named `pre_end_side_neck_reservation`; it checks the outward offset against a **pre-end band**, rather than disabling the bend guard.
- Retain actual **400 mm bend radii**, satisfying ≥4OD for both jackets.
- Report `external_route_constructed=false` and unresolved ports/supports/connection audits. A reservation-policy pass must not become a physical-route pass.

Quantitative single-pipe bounds for a proposed mirrored **|z|=3000–4000 mm** neck band:

| Screen | Result |
|---|---:|
| S-bend centreline axial advance | 734.082 mm |
| 100 mm jacket + **two** 20 mm face clearances | **874.082 mm** |
| Slack inside 1000 mm neck band | **125.918 mm** |
| Conservative radial reservation | **R2477–3099 mm** |
| Straight 100 mm bus jacket at R3029 | R2979–3079 mm |
| Jacket clearance to endcap / HCAL | **30 / 51 mm** |
| Rear elbow, R400 + OD/2 + two 20 mm clearances | **490 mm** |
| Slack in retained 500 mm radial-exit break | **10 mm** |

These are single-pipe spatial bounds. A 150 mm-high lane plus two 20 mm clearances needs **190 mm**, exceeding the **181 mm** endcap–HCAL annulus. The positive packed-area margins therefore do not qualify the complete bundle.

**Minimal HCAL policy:** retain the selected baseline’s HCAL context at barrel half-length **6260 mm** and endcap front **6760 mm**. Then endcap-back-to-HCAL-front space grows to **1100 mm**, but the unobstructed radial exit remains **6260–6760 mm: 500 mm**. Do not silently move HCAL with `compact_prototype.py`’s present endcap-following arithmetic or relabel 1100 mm as the elbow window.

Material interfaces remain substantive open gates:

- The proposed neck band intersects populated board rows and 100 mm H-rings centred at |z|3250/3750 mm. No swept clearance or pressure/vacuum penetration exists yet.
- The current endcap rear support is an unported 30 mm annulus.
- Preserve current **7392 CFEB slots / 3,784,704-channel capacity**; the older proposal’s 5888-slot statement is superseded.
- The moved warm endcap conflicts with the **prospective** collar reservation over **R301–450 mm, |z|4500–4850 mm**. That absent forward system requires an explicit handoff; do not erase the reservation or claim full-detector clearance.

The geometric leverage is clear: first/full endcap-envelope interception moves from |η|**1.3827/1.4876** to **1.2764/1.3911**, while full barrel radial depth ends at **1.2823**. These envelope values predict neither radiation-length minimum nor response precision.

Before reporting the variant, require unchanged local solids/materials/masses/readout counts, mirrored ±600 mm root translations, native combined overlaps and identifiers, sampling/upstream/downstream material scans on common rays, and matched transport/readback controls. Draw reserved routes as unconstructed. Any response comparison must explicitly exclude material effects of ports/necks/buses that are still absent from the native model.

events.text:
**LAR-GAP400-CaloTech-lanes**, source **7a9da4490f3bbe89f9d55fbfcadc795a3889139b**. **Yes:** this is defensible as a conditional spatial-reservation screen, provided combined utility bundles receive distinct allocations. No files changed or native execution.

The annular lane occupies **R2969.5–3109.5 mm**, centred at **3039.5 mm**. It leaves **20.5 mm** to both the endcap’s R2949 wall and the conservative HCAL R3130 boundary.

For **16 station sectors per end**, pitch is **22.5°**, or **1193.609 mm** arc length at the lane centre. Defining lane width as centre-radius arc length gives:

| Reservation | Angular width | Area | Minimum clearance to station-sector face¹ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Ordinary: 700 × 140 mm | 13.195° | 98,000 mm² | 240.856 mm |
| Utility: 1100 × 140 mm | 20.735° | 154,000 mm² | 45.725 mm |

¹ Measured perpendicularly at the inner lane radius. Both exceed 20 mm. Annular boundaries avoid rectangular-corner intrusion.

Unchanged packed-area requirements fit **individually**: barrel ordinary/utility **31,104/109,644 mm²**; endcap ordinary/utility **30,199/108,738 mm²**.

**Bundle-sharing condition:** paired ordinary bundles total **61,302 mm²**, fitting an ordinary reservation. Two coincident utility bundles total **218,382 mm²**, exceeding one utility reservation by **64,382 mm²**. Reserve barrel and endcap utility services at **different station sectors**. One utility plus the other subsystem’s ordinary bundle totals **139,842 mm²**, leaving **14,158 mm²** in a utility reservation. This establishes area feasibility only; individual pipe/cable placement remains unverified.

For the revised bus, ΔR = **492.5 mm**. With R400 bends, the single-jacket S-bend needs:

- **858.542 mm** for OD80, including two 20 mm face clearances.
- **878.542 mm** for OD100, leaving **121.458 mm** within the 1000 mm pre-end band.

Both respect ≥4OD. Keep HCAL **6260/6760 mm** fixed; its radial-exit window remains **500 mm**, with only **10 mm** beyond the conservative OD100 rear-elbow bound.

Ports, pressure/vacuum interfaces, cold headers, board/H-ring clearance and physical bundle connections remain **unconstructed and unqualified**. Preserve the historical collar conflict at **R301–450 mm, |z|4500–4850 mm**. The resulting 400 mm variant can study conditional endcap-position effects, while its validation record must explicitly state that reserved external services contribute no newly constructed native material.
